psychological_meaning: Crocodile is a muted, earthy tone that evokes feelings of nature, stability, and resilience. It suggests a sense of groundedness and practicality, often associated with the outdoors and a connection to the earth. This color can also convey a sense of timelessness and understated elegance.

real_world_examples.title: Military Uniforms
real_world_examples.description: Many military uniforms utilize colors similar to Crocodile for camouflage and blending into natural environments.

real_world_examples.title: Outdoor Gear
real_world_examples.description: Backpacks, tents, and other outdoor equipment often come in earthy tones like Crocodile to minimize visibility and match the surrounding landscape.

how_to_pair: Pair with creams and beiges for a natural look.
Combine with greens and browns for an earthy palette.
Use as a neutral backdrop for bolder accent colors.
Contrast with metallic tones for an elevated feel.
